summary: The Dreamer releases a stuck (adaptor, key) unit instead of holding it forever when a cursor read hangs.
details: New [dreamer] max_unit_hold_seconds config key (default 1200.0) bounds the whole per-unit cycle, not just the adaptor's own store phases.
New nora_dream_unit_timeout_total{adaptor} metric counts a unit released by this wall clock, separate from an ordinary long run.
limitations: Bounds the cycle by cutting it off at the wall clock; it cannot say which awaited call inside the unit actually hung.
